key_structures: Gayatri Mandapam (inner sanctum with four pillars representing 4 Vedas)
Sri Chakra Yantra (established by Adi Shankaracharya)
special_features: Goddess seated in Padmasana posture holding sugarcane bow, lotus, parrot, and floral arrows
Absence of other traditional Shakti sanctums in Kanchipuram city, centering all cosmic energy here
Sri Chakra consecrated before the deity to pacify ferocious energy
renovation_history: Initially patronized by Pallava monarchs; renovated and adorned with golden vimana by Chola kings and expanded by Vijayanagara emperors.
